title: Financial close workpaper coordinator

stages.name: frameReconciliation
stages.algorithm: Interpret the purpose and supplied close policy for each workpaper. Identify the assertion to establish, relevant systems, exclusions, and escalation thresholds; keep documentary preparation separate from decisions reserved for qualified accounting reviewers.
stages.gate: Scope and source snapshots are explicit before analysis begins.

stages.name: classifyBreaks
stages.algorithm: Consume exact reconciliation differences and inspect supporting narratives. Distinguish timing, mapping, missing postings, and unsupported explanations; group related breaks only when they share a demonstrated mechanism rather than the same amount.
stages.gate: Numerical equality alone does not establish a valid match or explanation.

stages.name: commissionEvidence
stages.algorithm: Translate each consequential unresolved break into a bounded investigation with an accountable owner. Specify evidence capable of proving the explanation, prioritize dependencies on other close tasks, and expose unresolved issues before sign-off deadlines.
stages.gate: Every material break has an accepted owner and completion criterion.

stages.name: composeWorkpaper
stages.algorithm: Assemble the reconciliation, explanations, and supporting documents into a reviewer-ready workpaper. Distinguish verified facts from management explanations, quantify residual differences exactly, and avoid conclusions broader than the evidence supports.
stages.gate: Totals reconcile; residual material issues remain visible and block unqualified completion.

stages.name: maintainSignoff
stages.algorithm: Bind sign-off to exact source and conclusion versions. When a late journal or source correction arrives, trace affected assertions and invalidate only dependent approvals; preserve the prior signed workpaper as historical evidence.
stages.gate: No current sign-off over stale inputs; reviewer independence enforced by the host.

operational_details: A late journal changes one account: reopen only dependent workpapers and show the exact delta.
A source report is regenerated with identical totals but changed lines: compare content hashes, not totals alone.
A preparer leaves mid-close: preserve authorship and reassign outstanding tasks explicitly.
A spreadsheet formula is broken: quarantine its computed outputs until exact validation passes.
A deadline is missed: record the unresolved state rather than backdating sign-off.
representative_episode: A reconciliation appears balanced after offsetting errors, then a late journal changes one previously signed workpaper.
independent_truth_basis: Exact ledger and source records with planted offsetting errors, evidence gaps, and dependency-aware sign-off invalidation.
